text:
sam-cs: FYI ACME hit a hard block on the billing-export tool. They're getting a 422 JSON schema validation error when calling /v1/tools/billing_export.invoke. Customer can't export invoices. Payload and error below. Anyone pick this up? :exclamation:

maya: On it. Can you paste the exact request (headers + body) and the response body? Also need request_id from the gateway logs if you have it.

sam-cs: Curl they used: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tools/billing_export.invoke \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"tool":"billing_export","args":{"billing_profile":{"customer_id":12345,"period":"2025-02"},"format":"csv"}}'
```
Response: HTTP 422 
```json
{
  "error":"tool_schema_validation",
  "message":"JSON schema validation failed",
  "details":[{
    "instancePath":"/args/billing_profile/customer_id",
    "keyword":"type",
    "expected":"string",
    "received":"number",
    "message":"should be string"
  }]
}
```
Gateway request_id header: X-Req-Id: rwd-req-20250315-9c3a

maya: Thanks. So it's a type mismatch (number vs string) for customer_id. Our schema expects customer_id as string. Did ACME recently change their client?

sam-cs: They said they upgraded their SDK yesterday. They were using older client where customer id was string.

maya: Repro steps I ran locally: same payload -> 422. Stacktrace from validator: 
```
ValidationError at /args/billing_profile/customer_id: expected string, got number
 at tools/schema_validator.py:118
```
This is a strict JSON Schema 'type' failure. Two options: 1) relax schema to allow integer | string for customer_id, or 2) auto-coerce integers to strings at gateway for this field.

jordan: For short-term customer unblock, I'm +1 on gateway coercion for billing_profile.customer_id only. It keeps strict schemas elsewhere. Need to ensure coercion doesn't let through other bad types.

alex: If we do coercion we must log canonicalization and emit a metric so we can revert if needed. Also need to check downstream billing pipeline expects string ids; lisa can confirm.

lisa: Billing systems expect string IDs (some have leading zeros for other customers). Coercion from int->string is safe, but we should not accept arrays/objects. Also confirm that customer id length checks still apply.

maya: Quick mitigation proposal: in api-gateway request normalization layer, detect args.billing_profile.customer_id and if type == integer -> convert to string, add header X-RW-Coerced: billing_profile.customer_id and include in logs. Patch should be small. I can prototype.

jordan: Please include unit test for number -> string coercion and one negative test for array/object -> reject. Also bump validator version.

support-bot: Incident created: INC-2025-0047 | Priority: P2 | Assigned: eng-runtime/jordan | Link: https://internal.incidents/INC-2025-0047

oncall-bot: Pager duty: eng-runtime oncall notified (alex).

alex: Sharing logs (from request_id rwd-req-20250315-9c3a): 
```
[2025-03-15T14:02:03Z] request=rwd-req-20250315-9c3a route=/v1/tools/billing_export.invoke status=422 body_bytes=345 validator_error='type mismatch at /args/billing_profile/customer_id'
```
Also noticed a small spike in similar 422s for the last 30m (count=12) from the same customer org id.

maya: I'll open a draft PR for the gateway coercion now and add the telemetry bits. Can someone approve quick review? Tagging jordan for review.

jordan: Will review. If PR looks safe, we can ship a hotfix to gateway and notify CS to tell ACME to retry.

sam-cs: Looping back to ACME: provided a temporary workaround (convert id to string client-side) and told them we're working on a fast fix. They accepted. :thumbsup:

maya: PR created: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/api-gateway/merge_requests/412 (title: 'coerce billing_profile.customer_id int->string; add X-RW-Coerced header; telemetry')

jordan: Reviewed. Minor nit on logging format, requested change.

maya: Updated per review. After merge I'll deploy to canary in us-west.

alex: After canary, watch error rate on /v1/tools/billing_export.invoke and filter on X-RW-Coerced header. If >5% for 5m, rollback.

lisa: Once deployed, confirm with billing team that downstream ingestion accepted the coerced values. I can monitor ingestion queue.

support-bot: Update INC-2025-0047: mitigation deployed to canary (us-west). Monitoring.

sam-cs: ACME retried and reports success for a single export. Going to ask them to run full export and will update.

jordan: Follow-up task: change schema to accept integer|string for customer id in the long-term model onboarding process, but keep strict validation for other fields. Filed task: TSK-ENG-8802.

maya: Closing thread here once canary looks stable. Thanks all.
